messages:
Olivia: Quick design check — proposing a compact 'stacktrace summary' row that collapses long frames into a single summary line with a chevron toggle. Thoughts on copy + screenreader behavior?
Alex: I like the compact row for scanning. question: when collapsed, should the summary include first/last frame snippets or just a single label like "3 frames collapsed"? :thinking_face:
Maria: Prefer the explicit snippet, e.g. "at handler.js:45 → ... → at db.go:210". Gives context without opening. For SR users we should expose more detail via aria-expanded + aria-controls.
Todd: Agree with snippets. Also think collapse state should persist per-user per-session (localStorage) so you don't keep opening the same traces. analytics: track expand/collapse counts.
Olivia: Good calls. For copy text I'm thinking: collapsed label = "3 stack frames — show details" and expanded action = "hide details". Short, actionable.
Alex: That wording is fine but avoid verbs that imply destructive action. "Show/Hide details" is standard. Maybe "3 frames — Show details" with a visible chevron.
Maria: For screen readers, aria-label could be: "Toggle stack frames: show 3 frames for request ID 1234abcd". But we should not hardcode request id into labels — use aria-describedby that points to a hidden element with the correlation id copy button.
Olivia: Good point. What about the correlation-id copy affordance? Right now the copy button is tiny and has no SR hint. Need a visible tooltip and sr-only text like "Copy correlation id".
Alex: Proposed snippet for the copy button: ```<button aria-label="Copy correlation ID" data-trace-id="{{id}}">📋</button>``` then a LiveRegion announcement "Correlation id copied" on success.
Maria: Also ensure keyboard targets are >=44px or there is a clear focus ring. We should add :focus-visible outlines and a focusable label area for the summary row so users can open via Enter/Space.
Todd: Layout nit: when summary is collapsed, the timestamp + severity chip feel crowded. Maybe move severity to the left and timestamp to the right in compact mode. Keeps visual scan density.
Olivia: Agree. We'll try severity-left / time-right in the comp. Also add a small helper text under the summary row (muted) if frames are truncated: "Showing top 1 of 3 frames — expand to view all". This is readable and helps discoverability.
Alex: Accessibility check: a11y-bot, can you run the checklist for this pattern? keyboard nav, aria-expanded, live region, color contrast for severity chip, and target sizes.
a11y-bot: Running checklist... 
- keyboard navigation: needs role=button on summary row and Enter/Space handling (PASS)
- aria-expanded + aria-controls: suggested string patterns (PASS)
- live region for copy action: add polite aria-live area (PASS)
- color contrast: severity chip requires 3:1 at small sizes; make chip background slightly darker (ACTION)
- focus visible: outline present but needs thicker 2px (ACTION)
Olivia: Nice summary. Two follow-ups: 1) content for the small helper text copy, and 2) exact aria labels for collapsed/expanded states (we should avoid repeating the full stack for SR).
Maria: For helper text: "Showing 1 of 3 frames — press enter to expand" (muted). For SR: "Stack frames collapsed. Press enter to expand and read frames." Keep it short.
Alex: I'll mock the updated DOM attributes and push a quick prototype. I'll also add a tooltip on hover for the copy button and ensure the tooltip is accessible (aria-describedby).
Todd: After prototype, we should run a quick user test with 3 engineers to ensure the snippet approach helps triage speed. If it's slower, revert to full lines.
Olivia: Plan: Alex -> prototype today, Maria -> accessibility test cases, Todd -> telemetry hooks, I'll update the design tokens (chip colors / spacing). Meeting sync tomorrow at 11am. :calendar: 
Alex: On it. Will ping when PR is up. :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks all — small copy tweak request: change "details" to "frames" in the toggle so voiceover says "Show frames" which is more specific.
Olivia: Good microcopy tweak. Final copy: collapsed label = "3 frames — Show frames"; expanded action = "Hide frames".
Todd: LGTM.
Olivia: Thanks everyone. Closing thread after the prototype lands. :rocket:
